business_summary: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates and franchises restaurants under the First Watch trade name in the United States. The company was formerly known as AI Fresh Super Holdco, Inc. and changed its name to First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. in December 2019. First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. was founded in 1983 and is based in Bradenton, Florida.
business_summary_ko: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc.는 자회사를 통해 미국에서 First Watch 상표명으로 레스토랑을 운영하고 프랜차이즈를 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 AI Fresh Super Holdco, Inc.로 알려졌으며 2019년 12월에 First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc.로 이름을 변경했습니다. First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc.는 1983년에 설립되었으며 플로리다주 브레이든턴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
